name: KPIT Technologies Ltd
about: KPIT is a global technology company with software solutions that will help mobility leapfrog towards autonomous, clean, smart and connected future. With 13000+ Automobelievers across the globe,  specializing in embedded software, AI & Digital solutions, KPIT enables customers accelerate implementation of next generation mobility technologies . With development centers in Europe, USA, Japan, China, Thailand and India [1]

sections.one_liner: Auto-software engineering firm. Revenue has stalled, margins are falling, and the key question is whether a Q4 FY27 recovery is real.
business: Software for automakers: software-defined vehicles, electrification, autonomous driving and AI engineering. 12,000+ engineers, software in 20M+ production vehicles [AR FY26]
Solutions & products are 21% of the sales pipeline; target is 50% of revenue by FY29 [AR FY26][Q4FY26 call]
Trucks & off-highway grew 18% YoY in FY26; 13 new clients added in Q4, 10 of them truck or off-highway [Q4FY26 call]
Revenue split by geography and segment not disclosed; customer concentration in Japan shown by Honda program cancellation [Q3FY26 call][Q4FY26 call]
financial_snapshot: Q2 FY27 (Sep 2026): revenue Rs1,691cr, +6.5% YoY; PAT Rs121cr, -28.4% YoY; margin 16% vs 21% in Q4 FY25 [Numbers]
Last 12 months: revenue Rs6,694cr, EBITDA Rs1,152cr (17.2% margin), PAT Rs533cr, about 36% below FY25's Rs840cr run-rate [Numbers]
ROCE 26% in FY26 vs 40% in FY25; ROE 20.9%; FY26 dividend payout 33% [Numbers][Q4FY26 call]
Market cap Rs14,639cr: P/E 25.4x, about 2.2x trailing sales, 4.0x book; Rs534 is near the Rs470 low, 58% below the high [Numbers]
trajectory: Revenue growth fell each year: 45% in FY24, 20% in FY25, 10.5% in FY26, 6.5% in Q2 FY27. The 26% 5-year CAGR overstates current momentum [Numbers]
Operating margin peaked at 21% in FY25 and is 16% now: three years of expansion undone in five quarters [Numbers]
PAT has fallen for 6 straight quarters YoY (-16% to -34%). FY26 PAT of Rs637cr is -24% even as revenue grew 10.5% [Numbers]
PAT is 45% of EBITDA in Q2 FY27 vs 68% in FY25. Likely causes: amortisation, interest and Qorix losses from acquisitions [Numbers][Q1FY27 call]
balance_sheet: Borrowings rose from Rs345cr to Rs838cr in FY26, then fell to Rs764cr by Sep 2026, alongside Rs630cr of acquisition payouts [Numbers][Q3FY26 call]
Debt/equity is 0.21. Cash of Rs960cr in Mar 2026 roughly matched debt of Rs838cr, so the company is about net-debt neutral [Numbers][Q4FY26 call]
Debtor days rose from 56 to 61 in FY26, as acquired Caresoft collects more slowly than KPIT's 44 days. Working-capital days still negative at -74 [Numbers][Q2FY26 call]
cash_quality: Operating cash flow was 1.73x PAT over three years and 1.88x in FY26 (Rs1,195cr vs Rs637cr), so reported profit is backed by cash [Numbers]
Free cash flow fell to Rs1,056cr in FY26 from Rs1,262cr (-16%), but still gives a 7.2% yield on market cap [Numbers]
Capex is about Rs139cr, roughly 2% of revenue. Cash surplus is going mainly to acquisitions and dividends [Numbers][Q4FY26 call]
narrative_vs_numbers: Management's margins sit above Numbers: FY26 20.8% vs 19%, Q1 FY27 17.2% vs 15%. Definitions differ by 2-3 points [Q4FY26 call][Q1FY27 call][Numbers]
Deal wins of $349m (Q4) and $257m (Q1) have not become revenue: Q1 FY27 USD revenue fell 0.6% YoY [Q4FY26 call][Q1FY27 call]
The May call called the FY27 environment positive. By July the target was a return to growth by Q4, and Q1 revenue fell 2.1% QoQ [Q4FY26 call][Q1FY27 call][Numbers]
The 22-24% FY29 margin target needs a 6-8 point recovery from 16%, and management says gains will be incremental until growth returns [Q1FY27 call][Numbers]
guidance: FY27 EBITDA margin 20.5-21.2%, after AI investments [Q4FY26 call]
Solutions & products revenue to grow 30% YoY from FY27, reaching 50% of revenue by FY29 [Q4FY26 call]
H2 FY27 to beat H1; return to growth by Q4 FY27; margins to improve only incrementally [Q1FY27 call]
EBITDA margin 22-24% by FY29 via products, solutions and outcome-based contracts [Q4FY26 call][Q1FY27 call]
Commercial vehicle segment back to growth in Q2 FY27; Qorix losses to continue for the next few quarters [Q1FY27 call]

ledger.delivered: Organic growth slightly negative (under -1%); reported revenue +1.8% QoQ to Rs1,617cr, helped by acquisitions

ledger.promised: Hold 21% EBITDA margin for full year [Q2FY26 call]
ledger.delivered: FY26 margin 19% per Numbers (Rs1,220cr/Rs6,455cr); management says 20.8%

ledger.promised: Q4 to be FY26's highest quarterly growth [Q3FY26 call]
ledger.delivered: Q4 revenue +5.8% QoQ to Rs1,711cr vs 0.7%, 3.2%, 1.8% in earlier quarters

ledger.promised: Q4 profitability better than Q3 [Q3FY26 call]
ledger.delivered: PAT Rs163cr vs Rs133cr, flattered by Q3's Rs47cr labour-code charge; margin 18% vs 19%

ledger.promised: FY27 growth higher than FY26 [Q3FY26 call]
ledger.delivered: FY26 growth 10.5%; H1 FY27 YoY growth 8.8% and 6.5%, tracking below
H1 FY27 margin 15.6% (Rs524cr/Rs3,366cr); H2 would need about 25% to reach the floor
Margin 16% vs 15% in Q1; EBITDA Rs267cr vs Rs257cr

ledger.promised: Commercial vehicles back to growth next quarter [Q1FY27 call]
ledger.delivered: Segment revenue not disclosed in Numbers

bull: Free cash flow of Rs1,056cr is a 7.2% yield; cash is about equal to debt; operating cash flow is 1.9x PAT [Numbers][Q4FY26 call]
Shares trade at 25.4x P/E, 58% below the high, against a FY25 base of Rs840cr PAT and a 22-24% FY29 margin target [Numbers][Q4FY26 call]
Customer base is widening: 13 new OEM clients, trucks/off-highway +18%, fixed-price share 66% vs 59% [Q4FY26 call][Q3FY26 call]
bear: Growth has slowed every year since FY24 to 6.5%, and Q1 FY27 constant-currency revenue fell 3.6% QoQ [Numbers][Q1FY27 call]
FY27 margin guidance (20.5-21.2%) looks unreachable within 12 weeks of issue; management has missed margin or growth guidance 3 times in 4 quarters [Numbers][Q4FY26 call]
European OEMs face 30-40% cost cuts, and suppliers are being consolidated. Fixed-price contracts move delivery risk onto KPIT [Q1FY27 call]
questions: Is the FY27 EBITDA guide of 20.5-21.2% withdrawn? What is the new range?
How much of the $606m won in Q4-Q1 turns into revenue in FY27?
What explains the 2-3 point gap between your margins and the reported figures?
What are Qorix's quarterly losses, and when does it break even?

annual_report.business: KPIT is a global AI-led mobility technology company serving automotive OEMs. Provides software-defined vehicle solutions, electrification, autonomous, and AI engineering across 15+ countries. 12,000+ engineers power 20M+ production vehicles.
annual_report.revenue_mix: Geographic presence: Americas, Europe, India, China, Japan, SE Asia. Product mix shifting: 21% of pipeline now solutions/products (vs. traditional engineering); 70% of new contracts fixed-price.
strategy: Build future-ready technology MOAT: AI engineering, solutions, products, M&A
Expand growth frontiers: geographies, verticals, adjacencies (robotics, aerospace, micromobility)
Amplify ecosystem leadership: partnerships, alliances, co-innovation
Deepen client relationships: outcome-based engagements on complex programs
annual_report.outlook: FY27 turbulent: two major SDV programs winding down H1 offset by new account growth, Trucks/Off-Highway, India, China momentum. Medium-term: solutions/products drive increasing revenue share; per-person value improves; profitability strengthens.
annual_report.capex_plans: Technology investments exceed 5% of revenue. Strategic M&A for focused acquisitions planned. Specific capex amounts not disclosed in opening pages.
risks: Supply chain disruptions, softer regional demand impacting FY26 H2 and FY27
Competitive pressure from China; geopolitical uncertainty
Major SDV programs winding down create near-term revenue headwind
Near-term profitability pressure from strategic AI/solutions/products investments
annual_report.flags: Co-founder Ravi Pandit passed May 8, 2026 - significant transition to professional management led by Kishor Patil (CEO/MD). Board refreshed: directors departed/appointed Jan-Jul 2026. No auditor qualifications or contingent liabilities disclosed in opening pages.
